**Kawasaki Z1000 (2014/2016) vs Suzuki GSX-S1000 (2016) — Brakes:**

**Kawasaki Z1000 (2014–2016):**
- Front: Dual 300mm petal discs, 4-piston radial-mount Tokico calipers
- Rear: Single 250mm disc, 1-piston caliper
- ABS optional (not standard on all markets)

**Suzuki GSX-S1000 (2016):**
- Front: Dual 310mm petal discs, 4-piston Brembo radial-mount calipers
- Rear: Single 240mm disc, 1-piston caliper
- ABS standard (on ABS variant)

**Verdict: GSX-S1000 wins.**
- Larger 310mm front discs vs 300mm
- Brembo calipers are generally considered superior to Tokico in feel and stopping power
- ABS more widely standard
- Overall braking performance and safety edge goes to the GSX-S1000
